positions.title: Android & React Native Developer
positions.description: At Genius Plaza, I collaborated with a talented team of engineers to develop an innovative EdTech platform aimed at transforming education for children and young adults worldwide. Initially focused on native Android development, I played a key role in building a secure, high-performance application using modern programming principles and the latest Android technologies. During a major rebuild, I transitioned to React Native, expanding my expertise in cross-platform development to enhance the app’s scalability and maintainability.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: During my time at Pursuit my duties as a T.A. included grading assessment exams, homework, and in-class exercises. I assisted instructional staff in developing the curriculum that was to be taught throughout the course which included Java fundamentals and a variety of basic and advanced Android development topics. I also provided mentorship  to students outside of the classroom.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: At SmartThings I worked with a team to help build a user-friendly, hassle-free IoT platform. My role was focused on developing and testing new functionalities, and features on Android. I worked with some of the latest Android technologies including Dagger 2, reactive programming with RxKotlin and RxJava 2, unit testing, and continuous integration.

positions.title: Observatory Ambassador
positions.description: Interactive role within One World Observatory focusing on guests' experiences by ensuring their safety, providing high-level customer service, resolving issues, and providing prompt and efficient assistance.

positions.title: Technical Apprentice
positions.description: At Safeco I assisted leading technicians with installation, repair, and replacement of state-of-the-art access control and CCTV systems.

positions.title: Porter
positions.description:
•	Maintained an organized and cleaned front desk, greeted tenants, and solidified relations with clients
	•	Managed reception and switchboard
	•	Input work orders for daily maintenance tasks
	•	Maintained control and safety of the lobby area in the building
	•	Responsible for solving any issues with building maintenance and tenants

positions.title: Assistant to Director of Operations
positions.description:
• 	Filed hardcopies and e-filed documents on the server
	•	Organized events for clients and scheduled appointments for the Director of Operations
	•	Supervised the building in order to ensure all guests and employees were performing in a safe and efficient manner  
	•	Managed phones
	•	Generated invoices and input data for record keeping

positions.title: Cashier and Food Handler
positions.description:
•       Prepared and served food for customers
	•	Performed basic cashier duties
	•	Cleaned work area at beginning and end of day
	•	Delivered and set up catering displays for outside clients

projects.title: Updated
projects.description: Updated is an app to help users keep track of the websites they frequently visit by notifying them of any changes made to the site without having to sign up for newsletters or visiting the site constantly. Updated is currently in Beta release on the Google Play Store.

projects.title: Espy
projects.description: An app that reminds you to do those things you were recommended by alerting you when your nearby. Espy adds the things you want to do into a list and you'll be reminded once per week to try something on your list. If you're out and about in the city and happen to be near a place that's on your list, Espy will notify you it's nearby.
